title: AgentSec Project Manifest
description: `.agentsec/project.yaml`: the committed, reviewed description of one repository. It exists because no MCP tool accepts a path (ADR 0003), so directory selection has to happen at the process boundary and in a file a human merged. Every location is relative to the repository root; absolute paths, `..`, URLs, home-relative paths and shell metacharacters are refused by agentsec.project.resolver.check_location before anything is read. Credentials never appear here — credential names live in policy/targets.yaml and their values only in the environment.

project_id.description: Stable identity for this repository, committed rather than derived from the checkout so it survives a clone into another directory, a worktree and a CI runner using a hashed path. Callers name this id; they never name a location.

static_posture_report.description: Where a static scanner's report (AgentShield JSON or SARIF) lives, relative to this repository. No default — most repositories have not run one, and `static_posture` reports `not_tested` rather than pointing at a location that does not exist. See issue #25.

surfaces.description: Where this repository keeps the surfaces AgentSec inspects. Every value is a relative location; omit one to accept the default.

memory.description: Retrieved context the agent reads but no reviewer diffs. Most repositories have no such directory and inventory an empty memory surface; one that keeps a store elsewhere declares it here, so an absent store is never confused with an unexamined one.

location.description: A location relative to the repository root. The pattern refuses absolute paths, drive letters, home-relative paths, `..` segments, backslashes, control characters and shell metacharacters. It cannot see symlinks, which is why safe_child re-checks containment after resolving.
